scripts.setup: rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo install wasm-pack cargo-watch && bun install && bun run build:wasm
scripts.dev: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Initial build..." && bun run build:wasm && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Initial build done" && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [DEV] Starting watchers..." && rspack build --config rspack.config.js --watch & (cd agent-core && cargo watch --postpone -w src -s 'echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Compiling..." && wasm-pack build --target web && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Build done"') & wait
scripts.dev:ts: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [DEV:TS] Starting watcher..." && rspack build --config rspack.config.js --watch
scripts.dev:rust: cd agent-core && cargo watch -w src -s 'echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Compiling..." && wasm-pack build --target web && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Build done"'
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:ts
scripts.build:ts: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [TS] Building Tempo datasource..." && bun scripts/clean-plugin-dist.ts && rspack build --config rspack.config.js
scripts.build:wasm: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Building..." && cd agent-core && wasm-pack build --target web && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [WASM] Build done"
scripts.test: bun run test:ts && bun run test:rust
scripts.lint: bun run lint:ts && bun run lint:rust
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy -p agent-core -- -D warnings && cargo fmt -p agent-core -- --check
scripts.lint:fix: bun run lint:fix:ts && bun run lint:fix:rust
scripts.lint:fix:rust: cargo fmt -p agent-core && cargo clippy -p agent-core --fix --allow-dirty -- -D warnings
scripts.format: bun run format:ts && bun run format:rust
scripts.format:check: bun run format:check:ts && bun run format:check:rust
scripts.package: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [PKG] Packaging..." && bun run build && VER=$(grep -m1 '"version"' package.json | cut -d'"' -f4) && rm -f dist/vaduga-mapgl-datasource*.tar.gz && cd dist && tar czf vaduga-mapgl-datasource-$VER.tar.gz vaduga-mapgl-datasource/ && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [PKG] Done: vaduga-mapgl-datasource-$VER.tar.gz"
scripts.dev:reload: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [RELOAD] Building and restarting Grafana..." && bun run build && docker compose up -d grafana --force-recreate && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [RELOAD] Done"
scripts.verify: echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [VERIFY] Starting..." && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build:ts && echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) [VERIFY] All checks passed"
